context: A couple debates a major family move out of the city
purpose: Teach: 引越し/倉庫/拠点/敷地/保管/申告/在宅/移住

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、本気で田舎へ移住すること、もう一度ちゃんと話し合いたいの。
lines.en: Hey, I really want to talk seriously again about moving to the countryside.
lines.style: Soft but firm tone, slightly anxious, seeking honest dialogue from her husband.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、僕も在宅勤務が増えたから、今がチャンスだと思ってるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, since my remote work has increased, I think now is our chance.
lines.style: Calm reassuring voice, practical and forward-looking, gently encouraging the discussion.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: でも引越し業者の見積もり、想像よりずっと高かったのよ。
lines.en: But the moving company's estimate was way higher than I'd imagined.
lines.style: Worried, slightly exasperated, voicing realistic budget concerns to her partner.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 向こうは敷地が広いから、荷物は当分そのまま保管できるって。
lines.en: The property over there is spacious, so we can store our things as-is for a while.
lines.style: Optimistic problem-solver tone, offering practical reassurance with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: それに余った家具は、近くの貸し倉庫に入れればいいわよね。
lines.en: And we can just put any extra furniture in a nearby rental storage unit.
lines.style: Thinking aloud, warming to the idea, building plans collaboratively with him.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 会社の営業拠点もあっちに移すって上司から許可が出たんだ。
lines.en: My boss approved relocating the company's sales base over there too.
lines.style: Quietly proud, sharing good news with measured excitement and reassurance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ来年の確定申告は新しい住所でするのね。
lines.en: So next year's tax filing will be at the new address, then.
lines.style: Practical, accepting the reality, mentally checking off logistical details.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そう。子どもたちにとっても、きっといい変化になるはずだよ。
lines.en: Exactly. For the kids too, this should really be a positive change.
lines.style: Warm and fatherly, closing the conversation with hopeful conviction and tenderness.
